steps.title: Scan your tools
steps.narration: Brunel connects to 27 tools across your stack — Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, Segment, Zendesk, and 22 others — looking for anomalies in usage, permissions, and billing.

steps.title: Surface findings
steps.narration: Brunel surfaces 19 findings: 3 unused Salesforce licenses, a stale Segment source emitting 4,200 events/day at $0.001/event, a data-export permission open to 14 users, and 15 minor anomalies.

data.subject: Weekly ops audit — 19 findings (3 critical)
data.body:
Weekly audit across 27 tools (2026-05-08):

CRITICAL:
1. Salesforce — 3 unused Enterprise licenses ($150/mo each). No login in 90+ days. Recommend revoke and downgrade to Platform.
2. Segment — stale 'webhook-prod-old' source emitting 4,200 events/day. ~$126/mo in wasted MTU. Recommend disable.
3. Data Export permission enabled for 14 non-admin users. Recommend audit and reduce to ≤3.

15 minor findings attached — permissions drift on Notion, 2 untagged AWS resources, 1 stale API key on Stripe.

― Brunel (via Joon Park, operator)

steps.title: File and track
steps.narration: Brunel files each finding in your preferred ticketing system, tags the owner, and sets a 7-day SLA. False positive rate: 6% — three findings are expected noise.
